vulkanSdk.provenance: Installed official Windows SDK; hash measured locally, not an independently verified installer digest.

ps5Vulkan.usage: Pinned upstream link-only AGC import stubs and RADV runtime/link recipe; restored into an isolated source cache

ps5Mesa.usage: RADV build script pin, not README revision; manually cross-built experimental ELF archive, runtime compatibility unverified

ps5Platform.usage: PS5_Vulkan bootstrap pin; GPL platform built only in the isolated PS5 experiment over the identical verified SDK v0.42 binaries

compilerRt.usage: Native Windows cross-build of ELF builtins including pthread-based emulated TLS; never use Windows COFF builtins

mesaHostPython.usage: Isolated Windows Mesa host tools; binary wheels only, pinned SHA-256, no global package changes

hostPkgconf.usage: Windows pkgconf executable extracted from the wheel without installing its incorrectly tagged Python metadata

spirvLlvmTranslator.usage: Native host SPIR-V/LLVM translator for LLVM 18.1; target is not a Windows library

spirvHeaders.usage: Native SPIRV-Tools headers pinned by the selected SPIRV-Tools DEPS file

spirvTranslatorHeaders.usage: Native translator headers pinned by its spirv-headers-tag.conf

template.usage: Research only; templates, UI and artwork not copied
